demo.title: private-payments.txt
demo.code:
You:   shield 100 USDC into private fUSDC
Bankr: Shielded. Your fUSDC balance is encrypted on-chain. Tx: arbiscan.io/tx/0x…

You:   save coffee as 3 fUSDC
Bankr: Saved. Say "send @someone a coffee" anywhere.

On X:  @bankrbot send @bob a coffee in private fUSDC
Bankr: Sent privately ✓ arbiscan.io/tx/0x…

You:   what's my private fUSDC balance?
Bankr: 97 fUSDC (only you can see this)

setup: Turn on Enable arbitrary contract calls in bankr.bot → Security.
Hold a little ETH on Arbitrum One for gas; private-token transactions are not gas-sponsored.
Optional, for private balances: create a Bankr API key with Wallet API on, not read-only and no recipient allowlist, and save it as the FHENIX_BANKR_API_KEY secret.
Set saved amounts in the terminal or Telegram, never in a public post.
